corrected_summary.corrected_shopify_share: 4 of 7 cards (57.1%) contained at least one identified Shopify merchant. This is up from the originally reported 2 of 7 (28.6%).
corrected_summary.correction_reason: Original report scored D2 as 0 Shopify stores (wrong — Quince and Brooklinen are both Shopify Plus). Original report did not audit B2's Redline360 (Shopify), B3's PRL Motorsports (Shopify, already known via shop.app) and MAPerformance (Shopify), or C2's Coilovers.ca (Shopify).
corrected_summary.audited_denominator_note: 3 merchants (Tein, HKS, K&N, TruHart, ST/KW, Ramair) were not audited because they are manufacturer brands named in additional product links, not primary card merchants. If manufacturer brands are excluded from the denominator, the audited share is 7 Shopify out of 15 audited merchants across 7 cards.

verdict_impact.reason: CATALOG PREDICTIVE required carousels in ≥8 of 12 (7 of 12 fails). The corrected Shopify share (57.1% of cards) would meet the ≥50% threshold, but the carousel rate threshold is still failed. VERTICAL-BOUND required Block D to show Shopify while A-C don't — A-C did show Shopify. SURFACE-DEPENDENT stands.
verdict_impact.what_changed: The headline number is restated from '2 of 7 cards (28.6%) — a floor' to '4 of 7 cards (57.1%) — a measurement, not a floor.' The original 28.6% was wrong in both directions: D2 was scored as 0 Shopify (actually 2), and B2/B3/C2 had unaudited Shopify merchants.
